notes.title: 2023.11.16.difficulty down!
notes.content:
As an adjustment to the game's difficulty level, we lowered the overall HP of the enemies.
A problem with player attacks slipping through has been addressed.

notes.title: 2023.11.11.Additional Update
notes.content:
The specifications of some stages that were found to have been omitted from the correction.
The specifications of some stages that were not corrected have been corrected.

notes.title: 2023.11.10.Additional Update
notes.content:
The following bug fixes have been implemented
・Set movement restrictions on own tanks
・Fixed the position of the generator
・Fixed a bug that causes your tank to self-destruct when buried in a wall.

notes.title: 2023.11.07.Additional Update
notes.content:
If a tank is buried in a wall,
The game is now able to warp to a fixed location in 0.01 seconds and continue the game.

notes.title: 2023.11.07.Additional Uppdate
notes.content:
When the tank buries itself in a wall, 
the specification to warp to a fixed location in 0.1 second has been corrected to warp in 0.01 second.

notes.title: 2023.11.06.Additional Update
notes.content:
Somereason, Latest version do not work.
So, updated.

notes.title: 2023.11.06.Additional support
notes.content:
〇The following additional actions have been taken
・Adjustment of the attack power and reload speed of the main Cannon, 
　and overall game balance adjustment, such as increasing or decreasing enemy HP
・Support for HP visualization of bosses
・Behavioral habits of some enemies

notes.title: 2023.03.27.Bug Fix And Balance Fix
notes.content:
Bug Fix
・Timer advances even when paused in the survival stage
・The red generator in Stage4 Level2 turns white
・Umpire drones no longer drop items in the survival stage.
Balance Fix

notes.title: BugFix_2023.03.11.Sa
notes.content:
〇The following problems have been corrected and adjusted.
・Adjustment of attack power of various main guns.
・Adjustment of obstacles in extra stages.
・Fixed a bug that prevented the main gun from firing while firing the machine gun.
・Correction of generator in Stage 2-Lv 3.

〇Added pause function.
・During a game, pressing the Start button stops the game
 　and Pressing the start button again will resume the game. 
 　Pressing the Select button exits the game.

notes.title: BugFix_2023.03.05.Su.Part2
notes.content:
Stage F-1 
　Just by defeating a boss enemy in Stage F-1
　Stage F-1 is treated as stage clear even if the boss is defeated.
　→Fixed the problem so that the stage is not cleared even if the boss is defeated.

Stage F-3
　Boss enemies do not disappear even if their HP is reduced to 0.
　→Fixed so that the boss enemy disappears when it reaches 0 HP.

notes.title: Bug Fix 2023.03.05.Su
notes.content:
We have received reports of the following problems, 
which have been We have corrected them.

　Stage F-2 and Stage F-3 are treated as stage clear 
　even if the boss is defeated.
　→Fixed so that the stage is not cleared even if the boss is defeated.

　When playing "Survival", the generator would suddenly disappear or would not work 
　when the remaining time was less than 60 seconds.
　→To prevent the sudden disappearance of
　　Fixed the problem so that the generator will generate 
　　enemies even when the time is less than 60 seconds.
